product_metadata.title: IRIS USA WOOZOO Oscillating Fan, Vortex Fan, Air Circulation, 3 Speed Settings, 6 Tilting Head Settings, 46ft Max Air Distance, Medium, Black
features: PERFECT OSCILLATION: Achieve full room air circulation like never before with WOOZOO oscillation. Set the fan to auto-oscillation to enjoy 65° of air circulation and ensure airflow that reaches every corner of the room.
3 SPEED LEVELS: Adjust the speed to suit your mood. From a light breeze to cool you off, to a powerful stream of air to reach every corner of the room, all it takes is the push of a button.
AERODYNAMIC DESIGN: WOOZOO deep pitch fan blades offer more air with every turn while minimizing noise. The spiral grid fan design allows better control of airflow, and superb precision in delivery.
QUIET: Circulate the air without breaking your focus. The motor of the fan emits only 35 dB of noise, so there’s no need to worry about disturbing the peace while you sleep or study.

COMPACT YET SIMPLE FAN: Enjoy the flow with our compact personal table fan. The fan will fit in your bedroom, bathroom, kitchen, office, or any medium or small room. Circulate the warmth or cold air from your table top or floor without the noise.
description: Maximize air flow in your house, office, or dorm with this WOOZOO fan. Three speed settings let you adjust air flow to your desired strength and the vertical pivot capabilities allow you to direct the flow of air in whichever way you please, especially when the oscillating function is in use. The whole room fan is powerful enough to reach the corners of rooms, and the extra-quiet 'low' setting lets you study, sleep, or relax without any noise distractions. The desktop fan provides up to 157 ft² area coverage, and the 62 inch cord makes it easy to reach the nearest open outlet.

details.Special Feature: Oscillation, Adjustable Tilt, 3 Speed Settings, Quiet, Lightweight, Portable
details.Care instructions: Wipe lightly using a soft cloth. For hard to remove dirt, wipe using a cloth containing a diluted neutral detergent.
